findings.finding: The Zvdot4a8i (vector dot product 4-element 8-bit integer) extension is not yet implemented in the Linux kernel source tree. No hwcap flags, cpufeature entries, context-switch CSR handling, KVM virtualization code, signal frame support, or any other reference to this extension exists anywhere in the kernel. The corresponding RISC-V specification is also absent from the spec reference directory (riscv-isa-manual), consistent with the PR context noting this is version 0.1 in early review. The security spec provided has an empty violation condition and vulnerability pattern, making a concrete audit infeasible.
findings.snippet: No code implementing Zvdot4a8i found in the kernel tree.
